behavior.description: Each ingredient traces one small elliptical orbit around an index-defined local center, beginning and ending exactly at its authored rest pose. This does not relocate ingredients around a shared product center.
behavior.totalDuration: duration + max(0, n - 1) * stagger seconds; 0 when n = 0
behavior.indexing: At setup, order targets by numeric data-index, breaking ties by authored DOM order; missing data-index targets follow in DOM order. Assign stable zero-based ordinal i and freeze count n. No frame-time randomness or DOM remeasurement is permitted.

path.evaluation: Evaluate these continuous equations at local progress p, or encode an equivalent elliptical path. Do not linearly connect the four quarter samples into a diamond. At p=0 or p=1, use exact zero translation/rotation to remove numerical residue.

behavior.restoration: Hold rest pose before the stagger delay and after the single complete orbit. End at x=0, y=0, rotation=0, scale=1 and absolute opacity=1; do not restart. The parametric path makes direct seeking and rewind deterministic.

adaptation.coordinates: x/y are additive scene-axis design-pixel offsets. Rotation is added to authored rotation in degrees; scale multiplies authored scale; opacity is absolute. The existing radial/scatter layout stays intact.
adaptation.resizing: Map rx and ry through the consuming scene's reference-coordinate scale, or reduce both at setup for tighter ingredient clusters. Keep the same index phase and direction for the whole application.
adaptation.implementation: Math strings specify intent, not a runtime API. Keyframes mark path progress in seconds; the path equations define positions between them. Duration is one target's finite cycle, with stagger extending only the group span.
